shortDescription: Resource module for Site Health Summaries Summary Analytics

options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center password to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center username to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco Catalyst Center to use.

options.name: id
options.description: Id query parameter. The list of entity Uuids. Example "6bef213c-19ca-4170-8375-b694e251101c". Multiple entity uuids can be provided with '&' separator.

options.name: siteHierarchy
options.description: SiteHierarchy query parameter. The full hierarchical breakdown of the site tree. Starting from Global site name and ending with the specific site name. The Root site is named "Global" (Ex. `Global/AreaName/BuildingName/FloorName`). This field supports wildcard asterisk (`*`) character search support.

options.name: siteHierarchyId
options.description: SiteHierarchyId query parameter. The full hierarchy breakdown of the site tree in id form starting from Global site UUID and ending with the specific site UUID. (Ex. `globalUuid/areaUuid/buildingUuid/floorUuid`) This field supports wildcard asterisk (`*`) character search support. E.g. `*uuid*, *uuid, uuid*` Examples `?siteHierarchyId=globalUuid/areaUuid/buildingUuid/floorUuid `(single siteHierarchyId requested) `?siteHierarchyId=globalUuid/areaUuid/buildingUuid/floorUuid&siteHierarchyId=globa..

options.name: siteType
options.description: SiteType query parameter. The type of the site. A site can be an area, building, or floor. Default when not provided will be `floor,building,area` Examples `?siteType=area` (single siteType requested) `?siteType=area&siteType=building&siteType=floor` (multiple siteTypes requested).

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
